mapper.sql: version_id AS versionId, file_id AS fileId, version_no AS versionNo, upload_id AS uploadId, object_version AS objectVersion, content_hash AS contentHash, size_bytes AS sizeBytes, mime_type AS mimeType, storage_encryption_key_ref AS storageEncryptionKeyRef, scan_policy_id AS scanPolicyId, scan_status AS scanStatus, version_status AS versionStatus, available_time AS availableTime, version, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_file_version (version_id, file_id, version_no, upload_id, object_version, content_hash, size_bytes, mime_type, storage_encryption_key_ref, scan_policy_id, scan_status, version_status, available_time, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.versionId}, #{row.fileId}, #{row.versionNo}, #{row.uploadId}, #{row.objectVersion}, #{row.contentHash}, #{row.sizeBytes}, #{row.mimeType}, #{row.storageEncryptionKeyRef}, #{row.scanPolicyId}, #{row.scanStatus}, #{row.versionStatus}, #{row.availableTime}, #{row.version}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND version_no = #{versionNo}
SELECT FROM t_file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND version_no = #{versionNo} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM t_file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId} ORDER BY version_no DESC
SELECT file_id, version_no, create_time FROM t_file_version WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) FROM t_file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId}
SELECT MAX(version_no) FROM t_file_version WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND version_no > #{currentVersionNo} AND version_status = 'CANDIDATE'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_file_version SET version_status = 'SUPERSEDED', version = version + 1, update_time = #{now} WHERE file_id = #{fileId} AND version_no = #{versionNo} AND version_status = 'CURRENT'
